title: Supporting Materials for "Distinguishing Romanized Hindi from Romanized Urdu"
summary: Building a romanized Hindi-vs-Urdu classifier from the CAWL 2023 release -- linguist-derived seed words, mT5 template-generated training strings, mc4 hi-Latn data, and Dakshina-based topline sets -- to route romanized South Asian text correctly in Meridian's language products.
